translations.web: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
translations.bsb: Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.
translations.kjv: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
translations.asv: Think not that I came to destroy the law or the prophets: I came not to destroy, but to fulfil.
